articles.title: IFGE calls for long term & balanced ethanol procurement policy
articles.description: The Indian Federation of Green Energy (IFGE) has called for a balanced and predictable ethanol procurement policy that safeguards the interests of both grain-based and sugar-based ethanol industries, according to a press release.
